description: Real attributed quotes from founders, CEOs, and operators.

quotes.text: Your margin is my opportunity.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

quotes.text: If you double the number of experiments you do per year, you are going to double your inventiveness.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

quotes.text: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Quality is more important than quantity. One home run is much better than two doubles.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: The first step is to establish that something is possible. Then probability will occur.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: If you are not embarrassed by the first version of your product, you have launched too late.
quotes.author: Reid Hoffman

quotes.text: Make something people want.
quotes.author: Paul Graham

quotes.text: Startups don't usually die because they run out of money. They die because they run out of momentum.
quotes.author: Paul Graham

quotes.text: Culture eats strategy for breakfast.

quotes.text: Volume negates luck.

quotes.author: Alex Hormozi

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: The most successful CEOs are the most boring.

quotes.text: There is no recipe for really complicated, dynamic situations.
quotes.author: Ben Horowitz

quotes.author: Jack Welch
